savings.roundup_body: This amount comes from your round-ups, tracked based on your purchases. Money stays in your account until you confirm — we don't move anything automatically.
savings.roundup_tooltip: We calculate the spare change from your purchases. You invest it yourself, through your own connected brokerage account.
savings.roundup_explainer_intro: Round-up tracks the spare change from your everyday purchases.
savings.roundup_explainer_how: Every purchase gets rounded up to the next whole dollar, and the difference is added to your Spare Change balance — automatically, based on your real transactions.
savings.roundup_explainer_example: Example: Coffee for $4.35 → rounded up to $5.00 → $0.65 added to Spare Change.
savings.roundup_explainer_invest: When you're ready, tap Invest to put it to work. Trades go through your own connected brokerage account — Arkonomy never uses its own funds or credentials to invest for you. Our AI may suggest where your spare change could go, but the decision, and the money, are always yours.
savings.roundup_explainer_toggle: When tracking is off, we still calculate your spare change in the background — you just won't see the running total until you turn it back on.
